title: Edit existing nodes for highline
description:
Existing structure nodes can now be marked as highlines after they are placed. Right-click a node (or a row in the Structure list) for Edit name or Has a highline. The highline checkbox in the name dialog is larger and clearer, and saving applies the same default name + H behavior as when placing a new node.

Who is affected: PipeSync Map Building + PDF Viewer on pipeshare.live (BASE). SaaS unchanged until cPanel apply.

Hard-refresh PipeSync, Structure Mode → right-click an existing node → Has a highline → Save.
changeLog: Add Has a highline / Clear highline on structure node right-click menu.
Add Edit name and highline options when right-clicking a Structure list row.
Make the highline checkbox larger and keep it in sync while editing existing nodes.
Refresh map labels immediately when highline is set or cleared on an existing node.
